name: Agentic System Architecture Review
summary: Review an agentic system's pattern choice (deterministic workflow, single agent, multi-agent), delegation and handoff design, state and memory, durable execution, and cascading-failure containment, vendor-neutrally, with progressive-disclosure references and a verdict that must survive a designated challenge.
security_notes: Static review only; never executes or deploys, never handles credentials or customer data. Framework behaviour is version-sensitive: verify against Context7 or official docs for the installed version before asserting it. Verdicts are proposals for the agentic-board-protocol decision process, never approvals.
